title: Executives draft next year's business plans with Copilot in a generative-AI working session
description: KB Kookmin Bank held a generative-AI workshop on 3 September 2026 in which around 50 executives used Microsoft Copilot to draft next year's business plans rather than sitting through a demonstration. The bank framed it as putting AI into the annual planning process itself.
outcome: The session applied gen AI to one of the bank's heaviest recurring documentation exercises, with executives producing planning drafts in the workshop. KB said it will keep strengthening employees' ability to use AI in their own work.
metric: Annual planning drafts produced with AI

title: Enhanced A2A Protect catches over 50% more fraud while cutting unnecessary alerts 40%
description: Visa launched an enhanced version of A2A Protect on 2 September 2026, adding a unified fraud score that is its first in-market integration of Featurespace technology and gives banks real-time risk signals on account-to-account transfers before money leaves the customer's account. A new graph-powered agentic capability speeds up complex fraud and risk investigations.
outcome: Visa says A2A Protect has been shown to stop over 50% more fraud while cutting unnecessary fraud alerts by over 40%, so review teams spend less time on false positives. Transfer learning gives banks immediate access to global A2A risk intelligence rather than waiting months for models to learn from their own transaction data.

title: Agentic KYC hits 99% data-extraction accuracy and points to onboarding in days instead of months
description: InCore Bank ran a proof of concept with Kyndryl and Google Cloud in which multiple Gemini-powered agents, wrapped in policy-as-code guardrails, extract and validate customer data, gather evidence, identify risk factors and produce explainable risk scores with auditable decision records. The bank reported up to 99% accuracy on automated extraction from onboarding documentation, with a compliance officer keeping the final call.
outcome: Up to 99% accuracy in automated extraction of data from onboarding documents, and demonstrated potential to cut client onboarding from months to days while keeping the process explainable, fully auditable and human-governed.

title: WhatsApp AI companion turns remittance chats into self-serve lending and savings
description: Cross-border paytech Félix said on 1 September 2026 it had raised $200m in equity and debt to expand beyond remittances, building its product line around a 'Cognitive Financial Companion' — a WhatsApp assistant designed to understand what a customer needs in their own words and connect them to the right financial service. Lending and savings are the first products it plans to distribute this way.
outcome: Félix serves more than six million users who already transact entirely inside a WhatsApp conversation, so the AI companion is how it intends to sell and service additional products without adding app screens or human agents. Funding is split between roughly $87m of equity led by Andreessen Horowitz and a $113m credit line from General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund.
metric: Self-serve product access in chat for 6m+ users

title: Chatbot rebuild wires AI Banker to AI agents to lift inbound resolution rates
description: KT said on 31 August 2026 it had been selected to rebuild Woori Bank's AI chatbot and consultation bot — the bank's non-face-to-face customer service channels — and has begun development. The rebuild links Woori's 'AI Banker' financial consultation service to AI agents so the bots can complete banking tasks rather than only answer questions.
outcome: Woori aims to identify customer intent more accurately and raise the completeness and resolution rate of inbound consultations, then extend AI from inbound chat to outbound calls and branch consultations. KT is applying its new Agent Connector solution, which carries customer context across chatbot, consultation bot, AI Banker and AI agents so conversations do not restart at each handoff.

title: Agentic CRM unifies member data and generates 400 leads in a single quarter
description: Ukrainian Credit Union Limited, a CAD 1bn-asset Toronto lender with 16 branches, deployed Creatio's agentic CRM platform to unify member data and centralise its sales and service pipeline. A 'Member 360' view gives branch, contact-centre, commercial and wealth teams the same real-time picture of each member, including full interaction history and active offers.
outcome: The unified agentic pipeline generated 400 leads in a single quarter. A knowledge-based Q&A tool is already live for member-facing staff, with next-best-offer recommendations, lead scoring and lifecycle-trigger automation planned for later in 2026.

title: AI value hits CAD 195m in three quarters, running ahead of the CAD 200m full-year target
description: At its Q3 2026 results TD Bank Group disclosed that it had delivered CAD 195 million of measured value from AI in the first three quarters of fiscal 2026, effectively reaching its CAD 200 million full-year target a quarter early. The first wave of scaling is concentrated in retail end-to-end credit, the software development lifecycle and contact centres.
outcome: CAD 195m of AI value booked in three quarters against a CAD 200m fiscal-2026 target, with AI streamlining credit application submission, automating document review and shortening speed to decision; the bank reiterated a medium-term goal of CAD 500m annualised revenue uplift plus CAD 500m annualised cost savings from predictive, generative and agentic AI.

title: Agentic security harness extended to auto-remediation, cutting attack-path resolution from weeks to hours
description: Visa announced the next evolution of its open-source Visa Vulnerability Agentic Harness (VVAH), extending the agentic workflow beyond discovery into remediation and validation of vulnerabilities. A closed-loop remediation step lets security teams feed structured validation feedback back to the agents to refine fixes that fail, instead of restarting the process.
vendor: Anthropic (Claude); OpenAI-compatible models via an LLM abstraction layer
outcome: Visa says the expanded harness materially reduces Mean Time to Adapt (MTTA) — the gap between discovering an attack path and resolving it — with some resolutions shrinking from weeks to hours. Visa also expanded its Visa Consulting & Analytics cybersecurity advisory practice to help clients prioritise remediation; VVAH has been downloaded by tens of thousands of developers since its June 2026 open-source release.
metric: Weeks → hours to resolve attack paths

title: AI investment steered at advisor productivity and back office, targeting CAD 700m-1bn of enterprise value by fiscal 2027
description: Reporting record Q3 2026 net income of CAD 6.0bn on 27 August 2026, RBC set out where its AI programme is being pointed: lifting advisor productivity, streamlining back-office processes and generating alpha in asset management. The AI use cases are being funded from within the bank's existing investment envelope.
outcome: Management reiterated an ambition to generate CAD 700m to CAD 1bn of enterprise value from AI by the end of fiscal 2027, framing it as monetisation beyond efficiency gains and expecting the work to support continued margin improvement; the quarter itself delivered 9% revenue growth, 11% net income growth and a 17.9% ROE.
metric: CAD 700m-1bn AI value target by FY27

title: Stripe partnership targets agentic commerce and wider cross-border payment reach
description: DBS and Stripe announced a strategic partnership on 27 August 2026 to accelerate agentic commerce and cross-border payments across Asia. Stripe will use DBS money-movement and cash-management solutions to give merchants on its platform stronger cross-border payment capability, while DBS taps Stripe's programmable and embedded-finance platform to widen its own cross-border network for institutional clients.
outcome: Stripe merchants gain enhanced cross-border payment capability on DBS rails and DBS institutional clients gain broader global reach. The two will also jointly explore agentic AI capabilities so DBS customers can transact more efficiently and securely as AI agents begin discovering products and completing purchases on their behalf; Stripe cites projections of AI agents orchestrating up to USD 5tn of global consumer commerce by 2030.

title: Relay super-agent takes over SMB payment operations, targeting 60 hours a week of manual work down to under 45 minutes
description: Cashfree Payments moved Relay, an AI 'super-agent' for small and medium businesses, out of merchant beta (running since May 2026) into general availability for all merchants. Relay executes payment operations directly off merchant transaction data rather than just flagging them — failed-payment retries, abandoned-cart recovery, cash-on-delivery confirmation, subscription management and dispute filing.
vendor: In-house (runs on Cashfree infrastructure; merchant transaction data not shared with external AI providers)
outcome: Cashfree estimates an average SMB spends nearly 60 hours a week on payment operations and says Relay is designed to cut that to under 45 minutes; the company cites seven in ten Indian SMBs still running payment operations entirely manually. Relay is free to all Cashfree merchants at launch, with outcome-based pricing planned as adoption grows.

title: Design partner for Gemini Enterprise cuts bond portfolio risk analysis to under 5 minutes
description: Deutsche Bank's Corporate Bank division served as design partner for Google Cloud's newly launched Gemini Enterprise for Financial Services, an agentic AI platform for credit risk assessment, portfolio monitoring and financial research.
outcome: Complex bond portfolio risk-exposure analysis, including automated duration-hedging strategy suggestions, is reduced from a manual multi-step process to sub-5-minute execution.

title: Scotia Navigator reaches 95% employee adoption as assistive AI actions quadruple
description: At its Q3 2026 results Scotiabank disclosed that Scotia Navigator, the employee assistant launched in April on its Scotia Intelligence platform for research, analytics and coding, reached 95% adoption across the workforce, with assistive AI actions up four-fold. Over 80% of the global workforce has completed at least one AI training course.
outcome: Employee use of AI to answer customer questions grew 17% quarter over quarter; the bank posted a productivity ratio of 52.5%, improved 90 basis points, alongside record quarterly earnings.

title: Lumi Assistant lifts new-employee productivity 17% on the Canadian banking frontline
description: On its Q3 2026 earnings call BMO quantified the impact of Lumi Assistant, the frontline chatbot that lets Canadian Personal & Business Banking staff pull answers from more than 8,000 policies, procedures and operating guides in English and French. New employees became 17% more productive with it.
outcome: Frontline staff resolve policy and procedure questions in the flow of a customer conversation instead of escalating; internal helpdesk call volumes fell by roughly 60%.

title: Website chat assistant to make member product research self-serve in one conversation
description: The USD 4.6bn-asset New York credit union is building a website chat assistant that indexes its own site so members can research products in a single conversation instead of clicking through multiple pages. It is developing the tool with the external technology provider that already supplies its call-centre communications platform, targeting a first release within six to twelve months.
outcome: Aims to remove multi-page navigation from product research and keep the credit union discoverable as members increasingly turn to large language models for money questions, cutting routine research traffic into the contact centre.

title: Agentic Investing collapses research-to-trade into a single conversation with ChatGPT, Claude or Grok
description: Scalable Capital said on 25 August 2026 it is the first bank in Europe to open its investment platform directly to third-party AI assistants, letting clients connect ChatGPT, Claude or Grok to a live brokerage account over the Model Context Protocol. Clients activate 'Agentic Investing' in profile settings and get trading, savings plans, watchlists and price alerts from day one, plus native search for stocks, ETFs and derivatives with news, real-time quotes and historical prices.
outcome: Research, screening and order entry collapse into one chat session instead of moving between an assistant and the broker app, across a platform holding more than EUR 60bn for over 1 million customers. Every trade and savings plan still needs explicit client confirmation, and deposits and withdrawals stay locked to the web and mobile app.

title: Agentic assistant rolled out to every business customer to strip out day-to-day admin
description: Starling launched Starling Assistant to all business banking customers as a full rollout rather than a pilot, letting SMEs issue direct commands such as ring-fencing a percentage of last month's earnings for VAT, which the assistant calculates from account history and moves into a dedicated Space. It also screens supplier invoices for scams and surfaces personalised cash-flow insights, with a new tool promised every week for the rest of the year.
outcome: Routine bookkeeping and tax-set-aside tasks that owners did manually are executed in-app on command; invoice fraud checks and cash-flow planning are folded into the same assistant, with accounting-software integration and agent-created invoices due later in the year.

title: 90-strong 'AI Crew' pushes Copilot into document drafting and data analysis in every head-office division
description: BNK Busan Bank said on 24 August 2026 that it had held the launch ceremony for an in-house 'AI Crew' of about 90 staff, drawn one or more from every head-office division, to apply Microsoft 365 Copilot to real work such as document drafting and data analysis. The crew's job is to find where AI removes effort in each division's own processes and spread the resulting know-how to colleagues.
outcome: The bank is using the crew to convert its Copilot pilot into everyday working practice rather than a licence roll-out, with each member acting as their division's AI lead. Through December it will run monthly offline workshops, Copilot and prompt-engineering training, department-level AI mission challenges and a hackathon to surface and share use cases.
metric: Document drafting and analysis moved onto AI

title: Ant International AI paired with BOCHK FX pricing to automate real-time corporate treasury
description: BOCHK and Ant International signed a strategic partnership combining the bank's settlement network and foreign-exchange pricing with Ant International's payments and AI technology across cross-border payments, corporate treasury and SME services. BOCHK will supply the accounts and settlement banking behind Alipay+ across Southeast Asia, and both sides will build treasury tools that pair BOCHK FX pricing with Ant's AI.
outcome: Aims to replace manual, batch-based liquidity and FX management for corporates with real-time, AI-driven treasury and cross-border payment execution across a wallet network spanning 50+ payment partners and over 2 billion user accounts.

title: AI payment facilitation picks the rail per transaction so clients stop choosing
description: BNY's global head of payments & trade, Jennifer Barker, said the bank has invested in AI across its payments business to enable intelligent routing and payment facilitation, in which a client's standing preferences on speed and cost decide the rail automatically instead of the client selecting an option for each transaction. Barker described AI as 'a capacity creator' that lets the payments business absorb growth without a matching increase in effort.
outcome: AI sorts a client's basket of transactions by desired settlement speed and the fees the sender is willing to pay, choosing the best channel automatically; BNY frames the payoff as added capacity to support business growth rather than added headcount.

title: Whole consumer loan lifecycle consolidated onto one AI platform with the bank's own credit-scoring engine
description: Hachijuni Nagano Bank, formed in January 2026 from the merger of The Hachijuni Bank and The Nagano Bank, selected the nCino Platform to consolidate its entire consumer lending lifecycle - from application through post-execution - onto a single system, integrating the bank's proprietary AI credit-scoring engine and adding customer and home-builder portals.
outcome: Replaces siloed, paper-dependent consumer lending workflows with one platform carrying the bank's own AI credit scoring; AI-OCR and chat capabilities are planned as later phases under a mid-term plan (FY2026-2028) built on targeted DX and AI investment.
metric: Consumer loan lifecycle on one platform

title: Weekly AI 'smart tools' automate savings plans, VAT set-asides and scam checks for customers
description: Starling launched 'smart tools' on 20 August 2026, a set of AI tools inside Starling Assistant that carry out money-management jobs on a customer's behalf. The first batch builds personalised savings plans, gives scam guidance, automates VAT set-asides and prepares business customers for Making Tax Digital.
outcome: A Rainy Day Saver reads income, regular outgoings and direct debits to calculate a personalised savings figure automatically. Starling says it will ship a new smart tool every week for the rest of 2026 before moving to at least monthly releases, crowdsourcing ideas from customers and eventually letting them build their own tools.
metric: A new money automation every week

bank: Baton Rouge Telco Federal Credit Union
title: AI loan calculators convert 17.7% of shoppers and drive $4m of loan activity in the first month
description: Baton Rouge Telco Federal Credit Union put Appli's AI-powered smart financial calculators on its website, replacing static rate tables with tools that combine real-time analysis and generative AI to give members a personalised loan-shopping experience. Appli built and configured the calculators to the credit union's own rates, loan policies and branding.
outcome: In just over a month live the calculators generated more than $4 million in loan conversion value from 150 started loan applications, converting at 17.7% — above the 15-20% range Appli targets for credit union partners. Implementation took only a couple of calls before the finished tools were added to the website.

title: Agent chain automates corporate credit memo drafting for relationship managers
description: DBS scaled an agentic AI solution that assembles roughly 70-80 chained agents to draft credit memos for large and mid-sized corporate lending, pulling external news, internal client notes and competitive analysis into a pre-formatted assessment.
outcome: Relationship managers and credit risk managers get a structured first-draft credit analysis they interrogate and refine via chat, freeing time for client engagement and risk management rather than manual drafting.

title: FalconTST forecasting cuts FX hedging cost in BARX NetFX
description: Barclays integrated Ant International's FalconTST 2.0 forecasting model into its BARX NetFX platform to predict client cash flow and FX exposure. Ant International's Falcon Time-Series Transformer (FalconTST) 2.0, a roughly 2bn-parameter forecasting model, predicts cash flow and FX exposure for cross-border payments. Ant International reports over 90% forecast accuracy and a state-of-the-art MASE of 0.666 on a leading public time-series benchmark.
outcome: FX exposure and cash-flow forecasting ahead of hedging decisions is automated, letting the bank price and allocate FX more precisely and cut hedging and allocation costs.

title: FalconTST forecasting paired with Fixed FX Rates to cut hedging cost
description: Citi paired Ant International's FalconTST 2.0 forecasting model with its Fixed FX Rates product to forecast client cash flow and FX exposure. Ant International's Falcon Time-Series Transformer (FalconTST) 2.0, a roughly 2bn-parameter forecasting model, predicts cash flow and FX exposure for cross-border payments. Ant International reports over 90% forecast accuracy and a state-of-the-art MASE of 0.666 on a leading public time-series benchmark.
outcome: Forecast-driven pricing of fixed FX rates replaces manual exposure estimation, reducing the cost of hedging and allocating FX for cross-border payment clients.

title: FalconTST forecasting model adopted across FX operations
description: Deutsche Bank adopted Ant International's FalconTST 2.0 forecasting model in its foreign exchange operations to predict cash flow and FX exposure. Ant International's Falcon Time-Series Transformer (FalconTST) 2.0, a roughly 2bn-parameter forecasting model, predicts cash flow and FX exposure for cross-border payments. Ant International reports over 90% forecast accuracy and a state-of-the-art MASE of 0.666 on a leading public time-series benchmark.
outcome: Automated exposure forecasting in FX operations replaces manual estimation, lowering hedging and allocation costs on cross-border flows.

title: FalconTST forecasting runs alongside SCALE FX under MAS PathFin.ai
description: Standard Chartered deployed Ant International's FalconTST 2.0 forecasting model alongside its SCALE FX system under the Monetary Authority of Singapore's PathFin.ai programme. Ant International's Falcon Time-Series Transformer (FalconTST) 2.0, a roughly 2bn-parameter forecasting model, predicts cash flow and FX exposure for cross-border payments. Ant International reports over 90% forecast accuracy and a state-of-the-art MASE of 0.666 on a leading public time-series benchmark.
outcome: Cash-flow and FX exposure forecasting is automated within the bank's FX execution stack, cutting hedging and allocation costs on cross-border payments.

title: Ant International forex forecasting model adopted for FX risk management
description: HSBC was named by Reuters alongside Citi and Standard Chartered as an adopter of Ant International's Falcon forex forecasting AI, which predicts cash flow and FX exposure for cross-border payments. The specific HSBC platform integration was not detailed.
outcome: Model-driven forecasting of client FX exposure supports hedging and liquidity risk decisions that were previously estimated manually.

title: Agentic AI in production strips admin work out of business onboarding and transaction processing
description: Dubai-based Islamic digital bank ruya put agentic AI into production with UAE enterprise AI firm Magure, running three live use cases across business account onboarding and transaction-processing workflows. The agents handle document analysis, verification checks and case summaries so staff spend their time on decisions rather than administration.
outcome: Three agentic use cases are live in production; ruya plans to extend the same MagOneAI framework to collections, compliance support, customer-facing assistants, personalisation and customer analytics as it moves to an AI-native operating model.

title: OpenRouter deal adds intelligent model routing so customers cut AI token spend
description: Stripe agreed to acquire OpenRouter, which routes and optimises token usage across 400+ models from more than 80 providers, for a reported $7bn+ in mostly stock. Stripe said the deal lets businesses maximise profitability by routing AI requests intelligently and spending tokens efficiently, folding AI cost optimisation into Stripe's billing and revenue stack.
outcome: Gives Stripe customers automated model selection and token-spend optimisation alongside billing, positioning AI usage cost as a managed line item rather than an uncontrolled expense as workloads move from experimentation to production.

title: Voice moved onto the AI servicing platform to end context loss between channels
description: NewtekOne went live with Glia Voice, bringing telephone calls onto the same platform as chat, video and secure CoBrowsing so its 24/7/365 client support team works in one unified environment. The bank says the consolidated platform is the foundation for real-time agent coaching, interaction intelligence and agentic AI that can independently handle simpler client requests.
outcome: Client service representatives handle voice and digital interactions in one place, and complex calls transfer to a human with full context intact rather than making the client repeat themselves.
metric: Voice, chat and video on one platform

title: Vulcan payments foundation model lifts payment success rates 8-10%
description: Razorpay launched Vulcan, a transformer-based AI foundation model built specifically for payments, trained on roughly 3 trillion data points across 4 billion transactions and weighing about 3,000 signals per transaction to drive routing, retries and fraud decisions. NVIDIA GPUs trained and run the model, while AWS infrastructure and Amazon SageMaker supported its development and deployment.
outcome: In early testing across more than 1.5 million transactions and 50,000+ merchants including Blinkit and redBus, Vulcan raised payment success rates by 8-10% and detected and stopped 8x more international card fraud, replacing rule-based routing and decline handling with model-driven decisions.

title: JARVIS collapses fragmented compliance checks into one automated risk view
description: Cross-border payments provider TransFi launched JARVIS, an AI-powered compliance intelligence platform that pulls customer and transaction data from its internal systems and third-party providers into a single risk-based view. It combines KYC and sanctions screening, internet profiling, risk labelling, behavioural and biometric signals and transaction monitoring in one dashboard.
outcome: JARVIS builds a risk profile against every customer, merchant, sender and recipient, running heuristic and AI-driven research to recommend actions on high-confidence cases and escalate only ambiguous ones to human analysts, cutting manual triage as TransFi scales across emerging-market payment corridors under multiple regulators.

title: OpenAI models deployed enterprise-wide with nearly all professional staff on AI tools
description: Synchrony announced an enterprise collaboration with OpenAI, deploying OpenAI's latest models across the company through ChatGPT Work, Codex and AWS Bedrock to speed product development and technology delivery. The card issuer says nearly 100% of its professional workforce has been actively using AI tools such as ChatGPT since 2024, and 90% of employees expressed confidence in its approach to using AI fairly and responsibly.
outcome: Employees fold AI into daily workflows across engineering, product development and decision-making, backed by job-relevant AI fluency training intended to scale high-impact use cases across the enterprise.

title: ChatGPT plugin opens a conversational discovery channel for partner offers and financing
description: Synchrony launched a plugin in the ChatGPT directory that lets shoppers discover savings, promotional financing and deals from participating Synchrony Marketplace partners inside a conversational session.
outcome: Partner offers and promotional financing are surfaced where shoppers already research purchases, adding an acquisition and engagement channel that does not depend on a separate app or site visit.

title: Full-stack agentic commerce platform turns merchant catalogues into agent-callable services
description: At its first AI ecosystem conference in Hangzhou, Alipay launched what it calls China's first full-stack agentic commerce platform for merchants, together with the AHA (Agent Hub Access) multi-agent cross-device interconnection protocol suite. Its AI open platform converts merchants' existing pages, product catalogues and service processes into standardised Skills and MCP units that AI agents can invoke directly.
outcome: Merchants without in-house AI expertise can expose existing catalogues and service flows to AI agents without rebuilding them, and pick individual AI business tools a la carte. Alipay's Ah Bao agent already routes consumers to more than 10,000 everyday services and is connected to 5 smartphone brands covering over 70% of the market and 16 automakers.

title: 'Parable' turns firm data into interactive analysis
description: Morgan Stanley built Parable, an interactive tool for analysing and summarising data, alongside LeadIQ which matches prospective clients to the right advisor.
outcome: Interactive data analysis and summarisation delivered to staff; LeadIQ automates lead distribution to advisors

title: LeadIQ matches prospective clients to the right advisor
description: Morgan Stanley's LeadIQ handles lead distribution and matching, routing prospective clients to the advisor best suited to them.
outcome: Automated lead matching and distribution across the advisor network

title: Proxy IQ replaces external proxy advisors on shareholder voting
description: JPMorgan built Proxy IQ to support shareholder voting decisions in asset management, substituting for external proxy advisory services.
outcome: Shareholder voting analysis brought in-house, replacing external proxy advisors

title: 34+ gen-AI use cases fully deployed; Erica passes 3.2bn interactions
description: BofA reported more than thirty gen-AI use cases fully in production across wealth, investment banking and engineering, with Erica cumulative interactions passing 3.2 billion.
outcome: 34+ gen-AI use cases fully deployed; Erica at 3.2 billion interactions since 2018

title: AI wealth advisor scaled across the wealth business
description: Citi moved its AI wealth advisor from pilot into scaled deployment, alongside agents automating work across multiple business lines.
outcome: AI wealth advisory guidance scaled through 2026 alongside multi-line agent deployment

title: Internal dashboards track developer AI adoption depth
description: JPMorgan instrumented its own Copilot rollout, classifying engineers as light, heavy or non-users so adoption could be managed rather than assumed.
outcome: Developer AI adoption tracked and segmented via internal dashboards

title: AI Coach scales planner-grade financial advice across the member base without adding advisers
description: SoFi extended its AI-powered SoFi Coach so it reads a member's full financial picture — pulling account-level data from more than 12,000 connected institutions — and adds persistent memory of prior conversations, visual explanations and defined escalation rules to human advisers for complex cases.
outcome: Guidance that previously required a human financial planner is delivered conversationally at member scale, with humans reserved for escalated cases; SoFi built the coaching approach on eight years and tens of thousands of logged human-planner conversations, and says roughly half of Coach interactions now cover investing topics.

title: AI portfolio realises A$141m of value in a year
description: CommBank put a hard number on its AI portfolio's contribution and expects it to roughly double again.
outcome: A$141 million realised value over the past year, projected to double next year

title: RASPEC speculative decoding makes agent responses 3-5x faster
description: Lloyds built a speculative-decoding framework to accelerate its AI tooling, tested on a four-agent customer complaints workflow.
outcome: 3-5x faster response generation on a four-agent complaints workflow

title: Harvey legal AI saves roughly 16,500 lawyer hours a month
description: HSBC integrated the Harvey legal platform across its legal function.
outcome: ~16,500 hours saved monthly for legal staff

title: AI now writes over 60% of code, up from 40% a quarter earlier
description: BNY's share of AI-authored code climbed sharply through the year.
outcome: Over 60% of code AI-generated, up from 40% in Q1

title: Gen-AI tools reach 72% of staff as approved use cases climb to 87
description: Standard Bank Group's H1 2026 results disclosed that 72% of employees were active users of generative AI tools as at 30 June 2026, with 87 AI use cases approved across the group. The bank says it is moving past tool adoption and use-case experimentation towards embedding AI as a core organisational capability, running a multi-model portfolio on AWS Bedrock.
outcome: Generative AI is now routine day-to-day tooling for roughly three quarters of the workforce rather than a pilot, with 87 approved use cases in delivery and 78% of migratable compute already in the cloud to carry further rollout.
metric: 72% of staff active on gen AI

title: AI recommendation engine personalises 10m+ client interactions in six months
description: In its results announcement for the six months to 30 June 2026, Standard Bank Group said its AI-enabled recommendation capabilities supported more than 10 million personalised client interactions in the period. The capability tailors what is put in front of each client across the group's channels rather than relying on broad campaign targeting.
outcome: More than 10 million client interactions in H1 2026 were personalised by AI-driven recommendations, extending individually tailored engagement to a volume manual campaign targeting could not reach.

title: AI portfolio delivers A$200m gross benefit in FY26 and is set to double and outstrip its own cost in FY27
description: At its FY26 full-year results CBA disclosed that AI use cases delivered roughly A$200 million in gross benefits over the year, about half of it earned incrementally during FY26, and guided that the benefit will double in FY27 and exceed the investment behind it.
vendor: OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS, Microsoft (ChatGPT Enterprise, Copilot, AI Factory, CommBank.ai GenAI Studio)
outcome: Around 80% of staff actively use AI tools, and the bank now runs a GenAI Studio bringing more than 100 large language models into a controlled environment; CBA invested A$2.4bn in technology in FY26, up from A$2.3bn, and expects the AI benefit line to cross over its cost in FY27.

title: Straight-through AI lending more than doubles auto-decisioned small-business loans and cuts SME credit decision times ~30%
description: CBA's FY26 results detailed AI-driven automation of business lending: CommBank Companion reached 100,000 small-business customers with straight-through processing for BetterBusiness Loans, while the BizExpress decisioning platform more than doubled the volume of auto-decisioned small-business loans.
outcome: Credit decision times for corporate SME lending improved by around 30% on loans under A$5 million, and the Banker Workbench AI tooling was extended to more than 800 frontline staff.

title: Agentic account opening on Schwab Advisor Center cuts not-in-good-order rework
description: Zeplyn's Agent Nexus was integrated into Schwab Advisor Center so an adviser can simply ask the AI agent to open a Schwab account: the agent pulls client details already sitting in meeting notes, emails, CRM records and documents, then completes Schwab's digital account-opening workflow field by field. The same integration feeds live Schwab holdings and transactions into Zeplyn's AI-generated client briefs.
outcome: Early pilots saw not-in-good-order (NIGO) submissions fall by roughly 80%, cutting the costly rework loop and speeding client onboarding for advisers custodying at Schwab.

title: AI underwriting engine decisions nearly Rs 1 lakh crore of MSME loans in FY26
description: SBI managing director Rama Mohan Rao Amara told the FIBAC 2026 conference that the bank used AI to underwrite close to Rs 1 lakh crore (about Rs 1 trillion) of MSME loans of up to Rs 5 crore each during FY26, for both new-to-bank and existing customers. A Business Rule Engine pulls together GST filings, credit bureau reports, bank account data and other unstructured inputs to make the lending decision.
outcome: Close to Rs 1 lakh crore of MSME credit underwritten by AI over the 12 months of FY26, with relationship managers freed from the data collection and preliminary analysis that previously consumed much of their time on each file.

title: Agent Cards let AI systems spend autonomously within preset budgets and limits
description: Mercury launched Mercury Spend, a spend-management product built into its banking dashboard that issues employee cards and new "agent cards" usable by AI agents; agent cards are created by a human but can complete purchases end-to-end without per-transaction approval, staying within assigned budgets and remaining trackable, auditable and cancellable.
outcome: Businesses get self-enforcing expense policies and intelligent budget pools (e.g. travel, software, procurement) that let AI agents transact directly on the company card program instead of routing every purchase through a human approver, with all spend controllable via Mercury's Command AI layer.
metric: AI agents can autonomously execute purchases within policy limits

title: AI knowledge hub unifies member answers across contact centre and digital banking
description: Tech CU, a USD 4.5bn-asset San Jose credit union serving more than 170,000 members, selected eGain's AI Knowledge Hub to establish a single governed, AI-ready knowledge foundation across the enterprise. The platform unifies the answers used by contact-centre staff and digital banking channels so members get the same compliant response wherever they ask.
outcome: Tech CU is targeting faster and more consistent member service by removing the hunt across scattered documents, plus a compliance-governed content layer that keeps the information feeding its AI reliable. It picked eGain for knowledge lifecycle management, composability and agentic orchestration, citing the vendor's Leader placement in the inaugural Gartner Magic Quadrant for Customer Service Knowledge Management Systems (July 2026).

title: Strategic partnership with Dubai Future District Fund to source and pilot AI banking technology
